title: KnowledgeHarvest
description: Output of solidsdd-knowledge harvest: durable knowledge candidates promoted from a finished change. Not applied until a human gate approves. Path: .solidsdd/changes/<change_id>/knowledge-harvest.json

candidates.description: Proposed knowledge nodes. Empty array → no gate required for harvest.

skipped_reasons.description: Why change-local facts were not proposed (ephemeral, trivial/tautological, already covered, living-PRD risk).

cli_suggest.description: Raw rows from solidsdd-kg promote suggest --json when available.

id.description: Proposed stable knowledge node id (e.g. POL-SESSION-TTL).

body.description: Proposed node body (prose). Keep universal; do not paste whole Brief.

rationale.description: Why this is a knowledge candidate: (1) extraction provenance from this change (Grill Q, Brief Means, Context section, existing POL extension, etc.), (2) universality / reuse across changes, and (3) what is non-obvious (choice, exception, or boundary). Do not use rationale only to restate a tautology or universality without candidacy provenance.

source_refs.description: Brief R*/SC* ids as <change_id>/<id>, Context paths, or feature paths.

link_edges.description: Downstream edges to write after approval (usually requirement → policy).

status.description: proposed until gate; applied after promote/file write.

maturity.description: Epistemic certainty. Prefer hypothesized until human confirms; apply after gate defaults to canonical.
